details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13 and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js). The script is obfuscated with a large encoded string array and a custom decoder, and its behaviour is not readable from the source. The package also declares dependencies on sibling packages (@or-sdk/base, @or-sdk/library-types-v1, @or-sdk/library-types-v2) that are known-malicious. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload at install time.
